dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #Alright, {NICKNAME}, who we gonna throw down with next? I'm ready to rumble!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: What are we waiting for, anyway? C'mon, let's gooo! Or they'll start thinkin' we're scared of 'em!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, but I guess you need some time to organize the victory feast, right? Gotta plan ahead for these things! ...Okay yeah, we can hang around here a little longer. Good thing I got this lollipop to tide me over.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Look, even if there are a couple o' tough customers lurking around this place, what's there to worry about when you've got Arataki "Numero Uno" Itto on your side, huh? Huh? Haha, there is nothing out there that you need to be afraid of.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Let's see who actually has the guts to face me. A couple o' whacks from my club will send 'em all running back whence they came! WAPOW! ...And if not, we'll let Ushi deal with them.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ugh, anyway, no use fighting on an empty stomach. Hey, they do food here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahaha, these books are actually pretty good. I bet the boys in the gang would enjoy reading 'em, too.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? ...Fairytales? You mean... they're meant for kids?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ahem! Uhh, what I meant was, we should totally share these books with the kids in the city! They'd be a smash hit with them!
